newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - SNORAS BANK SEES 15 MLN LITAS PROFIT IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - SNORAS BANK SEES 15 MLN LITAS PROFIT IN 1997.

text.p: Lithuania's Snoras Bank said on Wednesday that it was targeting a profit of 15 million litas in 1997 after posting a net profit in 1996 of 11.26 million litas.
"The shareholders of the bank have decided to aim for 15 million litas net profit in 1997," Raimondas Baranauskas, the chairman of the bank's board, told Reuters.
The bank earlier reported that its first quarter profit in 1997 was 3.82 million litas compared with a loss of 23,000 litas for the same period last year.
The bank is the sixth largest in Lithuania in terms of assets and is traded on the A list of the Vilnius bourse.
